title: PM Modi Dedicates ₹17,900 Crore Infrastructure Projects in Andhra Pradesh & Opens Alluri Sitarama Raju Airport
summary: Inaugurates Greenfield PPP airport at Bhogapuram and lays foundation for AP's 1st semiconductor facility.

blocks.content: Inaugurates Greenfield PPP airport at Bhogapuram and lays foundation for AP's 1st semiconductor facility.

items: Bhogapuram International Airport: Developed under PPP mode at ₹5,640 crore (capacity 6 million passengers annually).
Semiconductor Infrastructure: Foundation stone laid for Andhra Semiconductor and Innovation Park (ASIP) at Visakhapatnam (₹460 crore).
Heritage Landmark: Inaugurated 'Viveka Smaraka' at Sri Ramakrishna Ashrama in Mysuru, Karnataka.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Andhra Pradesh CM: N. Chandrababu Naidu | Karnataka CM: Siddaramaiah / D. K. Shivakumar.
